sg-p15.name: Umon Springsilt

sg-p16.name: Beko Oddpouch
sg-p16.brief: Buys used goods and repairs pots and bags; values reuse but hates losing purchase money.

sg-p17.name: Viss Mudboot
sg-p17.brief: Sells lawful scrap and marsh expertise; takes risks but refuses unroped beginners.

sg-p18.name: Oreya Leafscript
sg-p18.brief: Earns through carving and tending the grove; opposes taking ancestral plaques but teaches copying.
sg-p18.role: Keeper of the grove’s memory plaques

sg-p19.name: Doyin Hearthridge
sg-p19.brief: Lives on engineering fees and maintenance pay; despises pomp but wants her name on a water tower.

sg-p20.name: Hedran Copperbalance
sg-p20.brief: Takes mediation fees; values contracts while knowing old ones excluded workers.

sg-p21.name: Kaisha Fanwheel
sg-p21.brief: Receives production bonuses and hesitates to halt work, yet retrieves stragglers herself.

sg-p22.name: Due Saltvein
sg-p22.brief: Paid per sound crystal; accepts lower yields but fears apprentices undercutting his rates.

sg-p23.name: Ovv Coldhammer
sg-p23.brief: Teaches by actual stages and takes repairs; opposes unpaid labor but seldom lets herself rest.

sg-p24.name: Tiru Raillamp
sg-p24.brief: Paid for surveying and willing to teach; ambition makes him underestimate land negotiations.

sg-p25.name: Tisse Fishscale
sg-p25.brief: Sells fish and bargains for neighboring boats; respects learning but broadcasts scholars’ minor errors.

sg-p26.name: Elowen Copperring
sg-p26.brief: Lives on teaching and chart subscriptions; praises testing but defends his old book.

sg-p27.name: Pemi Candleleaf
sg-p27.brief: Copying work supports evening classes; trusting of learners, secretive about going hungry.

sg-p28.name: Izo Glassseed
sg-p28.brief: Sells seedlings and maintains heating pipes; hates waste but can prioritize rarity over patients’ urgency.

sg-p29.name: Navi Quietoar
sg-p29.brief: Charges per crossing; values privacy but gets defensive under suspicion.

sg-p30.name: Ruko Mirrorstone
sg-p30.brief: Cleans the yard for tuition; hungry for applause but helps fallen classmates first.

sg-p31.name: Fio Hotbread
sg-p31.brief: Bakes and organizes shifts; dislikes noble vanity but fears neighbors’ work being forgotten.

sg-p32.name: Sevia Greyleaf
sg-p32.brief: Conservation and search fees fund the archive; helps poor readers but can be rude about oral evidence.

sg-p33.name: Jolu Fivepetal
sg-p33.brief: Sells flowers and collects cleaning fees; rejects factionalism but reserves good places for struggling elders.

sg-p34.name: Myut Blackwick
sg-p34.brief: Requires proof of authority before opening locks; claims to care only for money yet fixes isolated residents’ doors free.

sg-p35.name: Asha Waterstep
sg-p35.brief: Maintains old drains; preserves relics but will break a beautiful door to save a life.

sg-p36.name: Grandmother Ither
sg-p36.brief: Sells cheap soup and teaches communal cooking; refuses to sell her key but may lend it.
sg-p36.role: Keeper of the palace kitchens and soup cook

sg-p37.name: Veya Mistline
sg-p37.brief: Draws a fixed harbor wage; prizes efficiency but has favored familiar captains.

sg-p38.name: Tavv Lastglow
sg-p38.brief: Supported by coastal crews and lamp repairs; reveres relics without sacrificing sailors to them.
sg-p38.role: Ancient beacon keeper and lamp maker

sg-p39.name: Nom Saltwind
sg-p39.brief: Lives on salt wages and boat shares; opposes low prices while collecting partners’ debts.
sg-p39.role: Salt crew leader and boat co-owner

sg-p40.name: Remi Mendsail
sg-p40.brief: Earns through sails and shelters; listens patiently but avoids her own origins.
sg-p40.role: Family tracing volunteer and sailcloth seamstress

sg-p41.name: Herri Tideclasp
sg-p41.brief: Guides and salvages rope for fees; once took dubious cargo, now refuses harmful loads.
sg-p41.role: Tidal cave guide and rope salvager

sg-p42.name: Othe Tideknot
sg-p42.brief: Lives on offerings and letter lessons; believes in forgiveness but denies it to himself.
sg-p42.role: Tide shrine priest and sailors’ literacy teacher

sg-p43.name: Jeshan Twoscale
sg-p43.brief: Paid by the union and calibrates publicly; opposes fraud but fears honest reports cutting off a village’s credit.

sg-p44.name: Aren Patchbanner
sg-p44.brief: Repairs wheels and organizes meals; opposes forced return but cannot imagine dying elsewhere.

sg-p45.name: Sulin Fairfruit
sg-p45.brief: Sells fruit and grafting; values caution but presses for results when harvest is threatened.

sg-p46.name: Grelan Bonechannel
sg-p46.brief: Paid jointly by villages; rejects being treated as an ancestry oracle yet is curious about the bones.

sg-p47.name: Wenya Windchime
sg-p47.brief: Lives on repairs and patrol allowance; insists on equality but struggles to judge kin.
sg-p47.role: Night patrol leader and chime repairer

sg-p48.name: Belin Springsnow
sg-p48.brief: Maintains the dispensary through community support, preparations and teaching; gentle to visitors, stern with donors seeking priority.

sg-p49.name: Harren Bridgenail
sg-p49.brief: Paid for projects and teaches basic building; scolds the mayor’s thrift but buys supplies on credit himself.

sg-p50.name: Tasha Hempcord
sg-p50.brief: Earns wages and laundry money; helpful but rejects permanent indebtedness as a refugee.
sg-p50.role: Inn server and mutual-aid meal runner

sg-p51.name: Soti Smallledger
sg-p51.brief: Salaried and writes families’ letters; trusts records but sometimes feeds the hungry before paperwork.

sg-p52.name: Ayvan Narrowshield
sg-p52.brief: Trades duty for training and board; hates being underestimated and does it to quiet peers.

sg-p53.name: Nera Redhearth
sg-p53.brief: Handles purchasing and assets; hears workers but instinctively claims final say over ancestral property.

sg-p54.name: Bozen Coalpalm
sg-p54.brief: Supports a household on night wages; encourages others but speaks over the timid.
sg-p54.role: Elected miners’ delegate and night-shift shorer

sg-p55.name: Melo Looseleaf
sg-p55.brief: Lives on lectures and surveys; favors access but underestimates equipment costs for poorer learners.

sg-p56.name: Vasser Sealcasket
sg-p56.brief: Paid for collation and custody; opposes careless dissemination and recognizes his own power in restriction.

sg-p57.name: Seti Homeearth
sg-p57.brief: Sews seed bags and copies deeds; wants ancestral land restored yet treasures dried fruit sent by its current occupants.
sg-p57.role: Village covenant keeper and seed-bag sewer

sg-p58.name: Dairu Newshore
sg-p58.brief: Repairs pumps and helps tracing; honors his past without calling settlement betrayal.

sg-p59.name: Aimi Nightlamp
sg-p59.brief: Receives a hospice stipend and teaches first aid; urges others to rest but hides her own trembling hands.

sg-p60.name: Hesha Fourwheel
sg-p60.brief: Owns four wagons with two hired drivers; values promises without making others subsidize every good deed.

sg-start-scout.description: You guide fellow travelers along the forest edge, undecided between settling and continuing a family search.
